title: Gingerbread Custard by Dripping Desserts E Liquid | 100ml Short Fill
description:
Gingerbread Custard Shortfill E-Liquid:
Gingerbread Custard is a warm and inviting blend that combines the spiced sweetness of classic gingerbread with the smooth, creamy richness of velvety vanilla custard. Each inhale delivers the nostalgic taste of freshly baked gingerbread biscuits, perfectly balanced by the mellow and indulgent notes of custard. This delightful fusion of bakery and dessert flavours creates a comforting and satisfying treat, making it an excellent choice for fans of spiced and creamy profiles.
Product Features:

Product Type:
Shortfill E-Liquid.
Bottle Size:
Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of flavoured E-Liquid, leaving space for Nicotine shots if required, e.g., add 2 x 18mg Nicotine shots (not included) to 100ml to make a 3mg final strength.
Nicotine Type:
Nicotine Free.
Nicotine Strength:
This E-Liquid is 0mg (before any Nicotine Shot have been added –
Juice Mix:
With a 70% VG / 30% PG mix, this E-Liquid is perfect for the Direct Inhale style of vaping using Sub Ohm Coils. Not recommended for MTL vaping.
